limits.validation: CRC, demux status, DVB SDT/PMT/EIT descriptor bounds; not a complete conformance checker

tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: Discover tool schemas and implementation limits.

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: Incrementally scan a local TS file; keep section evidence and version occurrences in this session. Emits progress notifications.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Read the latest observed current sections and derived actual-TS services at a packet position. Observation state, not a guarantee of broadcast validity intervals.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Get raw bytes, descriptor fields, errors and exact packet occurrences of one stable section ID.

tools.name: load_extension
tools.description: Load declarative PDS/table-scoped private descriptor definitions and service sorting rules. Rescan required. Does not execute scripts.

tools.name: preview_rename
tools.description: Preview a service-name edit to a complete single-section actual SDT; TSDuck serializes it and updates version/CRC. Returns a token bound to this analysis revision.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Write a new signalling-only TS (with null padding) or concatenated section BIN plus PID/provenance manifest. Never overwrite existing output. No media, PCR or original pacing. Optional preview token applies an edit to the selected snapshot.
